payload.summary: Corrected ri-04 to consume ri-06 project-context-runtime for locking, atomic operation persistence, and canonical ProducerResult while retaining architecture-specific provenance, freshness, and RPC status projection.

decisions.title: Keep architecture-specific deterministic provenance
decisions.rationale: Architecture input fingerprints and owned-output evidence remain producer-specific.

decisions.title: Reuse project-context-runtime operation ownership
decisions.rationale: ri-06 is the sole owner of Git-common-dir locks, atomic operation persistence, transitions, and ProducerResult.

decisions.title: Expose an adapter-specific RPC projection
decisions.rationale: Legacy coordinator callers need architecture status without a duplicate durable status model.

next_steps: Start wp-contracts, then dispatch wp-provenance and wp-adapter.
